entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`rowid` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `imageName` TEXT NOT NULL, `sha256` TEXT NOT NULL, `title` TEXT NOT NULL, `extractedText` TEXT NOT NULL, `tags` TEXT NOT NULL, `titleEdited` INTEGER NOT NULL, `tagsEdited` INTEGER NOT NULL, `status` TEXT NOT NULL, `ocrState` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `bytes` INTEGER NOT NULL, `isDemo` INTEGER NOT NULL)

indices.name: index_screenshots_sha256
indices.createSql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_screenshots_sha256` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`sha256`)

entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`title` TEXT NOT NULL, `extractedText` TEXT NOT NULL, `tags` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`screenshots`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_screenshots_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `screenshots` BEGIN DELETE FROM `screenshots_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_screenshots_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `screenshots` BEGIN DELETE FROM `screenshots_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_screenshots_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `screenshots` BEGIN INSERT INTO `screenshots_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `extractedText`, `tags`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`extractedText`, NEW.`tags`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_screenshots_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `screenshots` BEGIN INSERT INTO `screenshots_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `extractedText`, `tags`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`extractedText`, NEW.`tags`); END
